reference.title: Typical structure
reference.shortdesc: A sample structure (using the classic template) is provided below.

section.p: A sample structure (using the classic template) is provided below.
section.codeblock: csharp my-site/ ├── docs/ # documentation content │ ├── intro.md │ └── tutorial-basics.md ├── blog/ # (optional) blog posts │ └── 2021-01-01-welcome.md ├── src/ │ ├── pages/ # React/MDX pages (e.g. /about) │ ├── components/ # UI components │ └── css/ # custom CSS ├── static/ # static assets (images, etc.) ├── docusaurus.config.js # site configuration ├── sidebars.js # docs sidebar order └── package.json
